q: With the Ayresome Park gates padlocked by the provisional liquidator, Middlesbrough staged their first home fixture of the 1986-87 season at another club's ground. Which one?
hint: Hartlepool United lent Boro Victoria Park for the Port Vale game, weeks after a winding-up order and the sacking of the club's non-playing staff.

q: Who was Middlesbrough's manager for the 2006 UEFA Cup final against Sevilla?
hint: Steve McClaren took charge in 2001, and had already been named England's next manager six days before the Eindhoven final; he left Boro the day after it. Robson, Southgate and Strachan all managed the club, but in other years.

q: Which Italian striker joined Middlesbrough from Juventus in 1996, the same summer he had scored in the Champions League final?
hint: Fabrizio Ravanelli put Juventus ahead against Ajax in Rome, then arrived on Teesside for around £7m and scored a hat-trick on his league debut in a 3-3 draw with Liverpool.

q: Then club-record signing Afonso Alves scored a hat-trick in an 8-1 home win on the final day of the 2007-08 season — against which club?
hint: Manchester City were dismantled at the Riverside in May 2008. Alves had arrived from Heerenveen that January for a club-record fee of around £12.5m.

q: The last competitive match at Ayresome Park, in April 1995, was a 2-1 win that sealed the Division One title. Who were the visitors?
hint: John Hendrie scored both goals — the last ever at the old ground — as Boro went up as champions before the move across town.

q: Which Croatian striker did Middlesbrough sign from Lazio in 2000?
hint: Alen Boksic arrived for around £2.5m aged 30 and scored 13 league goals in his first season. He was among the highest earners in the country at the time.

q: Academy graduate Stewart Downing left Middlesbrough in 2009 for around £10m — which club did he join?
hint: Downing moved to Aston Villa after relegation, later playing for Liverpool and West Ham. He returned to his boyhood club in 2015 for a reported £5.5m.

q: Juninho left Middlesbrough after the 1997 relegation for a fee of around £12m — which Spanish club did he join?
hint: Atlético Madrid took him to the Vicente Calderon, and it was from there that he returned to Teesside on loan in 1999-2000.

q: Middlesbrough came from three goals down on aggregate twice in the 2005-06 UEFA Cup — against Steaua Bucharest in the semi-final, and which club in the quarter-final?
hint: Basel won the first leg 2-0 and led the tie 3-1 early at the Riverside before Boro won the return 4-1 to go through 4-3. Roma, Stuttgart and Xanthi were all beaten earlier in the same run.
